sections.title: 1.1Purpose
sections.text_preview: This specifications establishes the requirements for the product named Qheadache. The intended audience is the analyst, programmer and tester of Qheadache.

sections.title: 1.2Scope
sections.text_preview: The product is a computerized game that displays an interface used to solve a specific headache.

sections.title: 1.3Definitions, Acronyms, and Abbreviations
sections.text_preview: Not applicable.

sections.title: 1.4References
sections.text_preview: Not applicable.

sections.title: 1.5SRS Document Overview
sections.text_preview: The remaining sections of this document provide a general description, including characteristics of the users of this project, the product's hardware, and the functional and data requirements of the p

sections.title: 2.1.1User Interfaces
sections.text_preview:
The product runs as a stand­alone application.

Its user interface uses menus, graphics and sounds.

sections.title: 2.1.2Hardware Interfaces
sections.text_preview: The product requires the use of a keyboard and a mouse to interface with the user. It requires  a graphical display of at least 800\*600 resolution.

sections.title: 2.1.3Software Interfaces
sections.text_preview: The product uses the Qt graphical library. It must run with all the operating systems that Qt supports.

sections.title: 2.1.4Communications Interfaces
sections.text_preview: Not applicable.

sections.title: 2.1.5Memory Constraints
sections.text_preview: Not applicable.

sections.title: 2.1.6Site Adaptation Requirements
sections.text_preview: Not applicable.

sections.title: 2.2.1Undo et Redo Actions.
sections.text_preview: The user must undo and redo its last thousand actions.

sections.title: 2.2.2Time passed to play.
sections.text_preview: The product must count and display the time that the user uses to play.

sections.title: 2.2.3Count of action number.
sections.text_preview: The product must count and display the number of the user's action.

sections.title: 2.2.4Score.
sections.text_preview: The product must record the score (time and number of counts) of a play associated with the name of a user.

sections.title: 2.2.5Score window.
sections.text_preview: The product must display a window with all the player's  cores.

sections.title: 2.3User Characteristics
sections.text_preview: No qualification is necessary.

sections.text_preview: The users consist of anyone who wants to play a simple game who knows how to operate a computer, with a beginning level player starting at age 8, up through an advanced level player who could be an ad

sections.text_preview:

– A board, see chapter 3.2.1.1.

– a menu bar, see chapter 3.2.5.

sections.title: 3.2.1.1Presentation of the board.
sections.text_preview: The board is a rectangular zone where the user could move some blocks. Let x be the mesure unit. The height of the board game is 5x, its width is 4x : x can't be less than 50 pixels and greater than 1

sections.title: 2x.
sections.text_preview:
There is one square block with a side of 2x.

The board is black and the blocks are yellow.
